evidence.kind: user-supplied photograph and independently retrieved handset report

observed.platform: PLATFORM_MSM8992: six expected CPUs and GICv2 verified.

interpretation: The v2 report writer succeeded on actual handset FAT media, and the persisted content was read back.
The firmware protocol exists, but clk_get returned null for all three specific queried names.
All three sampled branches have halt bit 31 set and software enable bit 0 clear.
Both power domains remain collapsed; no GPU identity or SMMU register reads were attempted.
AHB_CBCR differs from v1: 0x80008000 here versus 0x00008000 before. These are distinct boot observations, not a measured transition caused by the diagnostic.
not_proven: Whether other clock aliases or other firmware power-control interfaces exist.
A complete regulator, parent-clock, interconnect or power-domain initialization sequence.
GPU identity, GPU execution, rendering or Metal.
Actual GIC interrupt delivery, XNU entry or iOS userland.
